summary: Regulatory evidence binder: verifiable egress proof, timebound SFTP snapshot, and completed security questionnaire
description:
Issue summary: NorthBridge Bank (FCA-regulated) requests a timeboxed evidence bundle for an upcoming regulatory review. They require verifiable proof of outbound network egress for audit events, a one-time SFTP snapshot delivery with IP-allowlisted presigned URLs, and completed responses to a 120-question security questionnaire.

Impact: Customer expects this evidence to be ingested by their compliance team by 2026-03-18. Missing items or unverifiable checks will delay regulatory audit and may require contract escalation.

Environment: prod/us-east, tenant: northbridge-prod, audit stream: activity-events-v2.

Requested deliverables: 
1) A signed (ED25519) manifest SHA256 of an exported delta snapshot covering 2026-03-01T00:00:00Z to 2026-03-09T23:59:59Z. Manifest must include per-file checksums, UTC canonical timestamps, and a Redacted/Unredacted file map.
2) Network egress proof: VPC flow logs and egress_nic tagging showing outbound connections used by the snapshot delivery, with destination_asn, destination_ip, TLS SNI, and socket-level TLS cipher. Proof must include HSM-attested signing statement (or KMS-signed assertion) and sample verification commands.
3) One-time SFTP delivery: presigned SFTP URL(s) or SFTP endpoint credentials with IP allowlist and expiry (no longer than 72 hours). If SFTP cannot provide presigned URLs, provide an S3 presign flow with per-file encrypted envelopes and an SFTP fall-back.
4) Completed security questionnaire: the customer's supplied 120-question XLSX (attached) filled in, with references to Confluence pages or runbook links where appropriate.
5) A small sample CSV (50 events) mapped to the customer's field names (activity_id, actor_email, tenant_id, event_type, created_at, event_payload_hash) and a crosswalk doc.

Steps/supporting notes: customer provided an attachable questionnaire and a target compliance ingestion team. They request proof that the snapshot sent came from our prod export pipeline (not from a backup or staging). They also want evidence that only the intended files were exported and that access keys used for transfer were ephemeral and rotated.
steps_to_reproduce: N/A - information/evidence request rather than a functional bug. Operational steps for internal run: 1) Reproduce export in staging to validate manifest format. 2) Sign manifest with HSM/KMS in prod. 3) Create presigned transfer artifacts and test download from allowed IP. 4) Collate VPC flow logs and sign egress proof artifact.

resolution_notes: Pending - work in progress. Partial deliverable: staging presign and sample CSV validated on 2026-03-12. HSM signing and flow-log extraction scheduled for 2026-03-13 production window.

Final bundle will include: ED25519-signed manifest, HSM signing statement with key fingerprint, VPC flow log slice (gz) with verified egress_nic mappings, IP-allowlisted presigned SFTP/S3 transfer, completed questionnaire XLSX, and a crosswalk CSV.
Follow-up actions: Create runbook entry for ad-hoc regulatory evidence exports and update manifest schema docs on Confluence. Notify Customer Success for uplift review before closing.
public_resolution_summary: Provide a timeboxed regulatory evidence bundle including a signed manifest, verifiable network egress logs, one-time delivery artifact (IP-allowlisted), and a completed security questionnaire. ETA for final deliverables: 2026-03-15.
private_notes: Ensure HSM signing occurs during staffed window; do not reuse staging keys for production signing.
Coordinate IP allowlist with infra firewall team and legal for presigned artifact terms.
